items.headline: Stokes throws for career-high 5TDs in Memphis' 59-8 drubbing of Charlotte
items.description: — Marcus Stokes threw for a career-high five touchdowns and Memphis routed Charlotte 59-8 on Saturday in an American Conference opener.

items.description: After a controversial last-second win earlier in the season, the tables were turned on the Wolverines.

items.headline: Memphis and Charlotte meet in AAC play
items.description: Memphis (3-1) at Charlotte (0-4), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Winfield rushes, throws for TDs to lead Louisiana-Lafayette over Charlotte 34-7
items.description: — Lunch Winfield rushed for a touchdown and threw for another, Anthony Reagan Jr. and JJ Garner also had rushing scores, and Louisiana-Lafayette took down Charlotte 34-7 on Saturday.
